bullets.text: A learning model links reservoirs, power and crops to guide water allocation.
The model outperforms a standard learning model when monitoring data arrive late.
Model performance barely changes with data up to five months out of date.
Hetao's water diversion point is most sensitive to delayed monitoring data.
The results pinpoint where faster monitoring could most benefit water management.

rationale: Plain wording for physical connections, comparison, five-month delay robustness, vulnerable diversion point and monitoring priorities; no unverified conversion of penalty reduction to water savings.
